   115	    def __init__(self, client: GoogleAdsClient):
   116	        self.client = client

   118	
   119	    def _classify(self, name: str) -> str:
   120	        name = name.lower()
   121	        if any(k in name for k in KEYWORDS["BRAND"]): return "brand"
   122	        if any(k in name for k in KEYWORDS["PMAX"]): return "pmax"
   123	        if any(k in name for k in KEYWORDS["DEMAND"]): return "demand_gen"
   124	        return "others"

   126	    def fetch_account_data(self, customer_id: str, start: str, end: str, name: str) -> AccountMetrics:
   127	        cid = re.sub(r'[^0-9]', '', customer_id)
   128	        metrics = AccountMetrics(account_name=name)
   129	        if not cid: return metrics
   130	
   131	        # Cost Query
   132	        cost_q = f"SELECT campaign.name, metrics.cost_micros FROM campaign WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}'"
   133	        try:
   134	            for batch in self.ga_service.search_stream(customer_id=cid, query=cost_q):
   135	                for row in batch.results:
   136	                    cat = self._classify(row.campaign.name)
   137	                    getattr(metrics, cat).cost += row.metrics.cost_micros / 1_000_000
   138	        except Exception as e: print(f"[GoogleAds] {name} 비용 수집 실패: {e}")
   139	
   140	        # Conversion Query
   141	        conv_q = f"SELECT campaign.name, segments.conversion_action_name, metrics.conversions FROM campaign WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}'"
   142	        try:
   143	            for batch in self.ga_service.search_stream(customer_id=cid, query=conv_q):
   144	                for row in batch.results:
   145	                    cat = self._classify(row.campaign.name)
   146	                    action = row.segments.conversion_action_name.lower()
   147	                    val = row.metrics.conversions
   148	                    m = getattr(metrics, cat)
   149	                    if any(k in action for k in KEYWORDS["LEADS"]): m.leads += val
   150	                    elif any(k in action for k in KEYWORDS["SIGNUP"]): m.signup += val
   151	                    elif any(k in action for k in KEYWORDS["PURCHASE"]): m.purchase += val
   152	        except Exception as e: print(f"[GoogleAds] {name} 전환 수집 실패: {e}")
   153	
   154	        metrics.finalize()
   155	        return metrics

   113	# --- Services: Data Fetchers ---
   114	class GoogleAdsService:
   115	    def __init__(self, client: GoogleAdsClient):
   116	        self.client = client
   117	        self.ga_service = client.get_service("GoogleAdsService")
   118	
   119	    def _classify(self, name: str) -> str:
   120	        name = name.lower()
   121	        if any(k in name for k in KEYWORDS["BRAND"]): return "brand"
   122	        if any(k in name for k in KEYWORDS["PMAX"]): return "pmax"
   123	        if any(k in name for k in KEYWORDS["DEMAND"]): return "demand_gen"
   124	        return "others"
   125	
   126	    def fetch_account_data(self, customer_id: str, start: str, end: str, name: str) -> AccountMetrics:
   127	        cid = re.sub(r'[^0-9]', '', customer_id)
   128	        metrics = AccountMetrics(account_name=name)
   129	        if not cid: return metrics
   130	
   131	        # Cost Query
   132	        cost_q = f"SELECT campaign.name, metrics.cost_micros FROM campaign WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}'"
   133	        try:
   134	            for batch in self.ga_service.search_stream(customer_id=cid, query=cost_q):
   135	                for row in batch.results:
   136	                    cat = self._classify(row.campaign.name)
   137	                    getattr(metrics, cat).cost += row.metrics.cost_micros / 1_000_000
   138	        except Exception as e: print(f"[GoogleAds] {name} 비용 수집 실패: {e}")
   139	
   140	        # Conversion Query
   141	        conv_q = f"SELECT campaign.name, segments.conversion_action_name, metrics.conversions FROM campaign WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}'"
   142	        try:
   143	            for batch in self.ga_service.search_stream(customer_id=cid, query=conv_q):
   144	                for row in batch.results:
   145	                    cat = self._classify(row.campaign.name)
   146	                    action = row.segments.conversion_action_name.lower()
   147	                    val = row.metrics.conversions
   148	                    m = getattr(metrics, cat)
   149	                    if any(k in action for k in KEYWORDS["LEADS"]): m.leads += val
   150	                    elif any(k in action for k in KEYWORDS["SIGNUP"]): m.signup += val
   151	                    elif any(k in action for k in KEYWORDS["PURCHASE"]): m.purchase += val
   152	        except Exception as e: print(f"[GoogleAds] {name} 전환 수집 실패: {e}")
   153	
   154	        metrics.finalize()
   155	        return metrics

   157	class NaverAdsService:

   164	    def _get_header(self, method: str, uri: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
   165	        ts = str(int(time.time() * 1000))
   166	        signature = base64.b64encode(hmac.new(self.secret.encode(), f'{ts}.{method}.{uri}'.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()).decode()
   167	        return {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Timestamp': ts, 'X-API-KEY': self.license, 'X-Customer': self.customer, 'X-Signature': signature}
   168	
   169	    def fetch_data(self, start: str, end: str) -> Metrics:
   170	        res = Metrics()
   171	        if not all([self.license, self.secret, self.customer]): return res
   172	        
   173	        try:
   174	            # 1. 전환 유형 매핑 확인 (구매완료, 회원가입 등)
   175	            conv_map = {"purchase": "convCnt1", "signup": "convCnt2"} # 기본값
   176	            try:
   177	                # 네이버 SA에서 사용중인 전환 유형 리스트 조회
   178	                ct_resp = requests.get(f"{self.base_url}/ncc/conversion-types", headers=self._get_header('GET', '/ncc/conversion-types'))
   179	                if ct_resp.status_code == 200:
   180	                    types = ct_resp.json()
   181	                    for t in types:
   182	                        name = t.get('name', '')
   183	                        # 인덱스는 보통 1부터 시작 (convCnt1, convCnt2...)
   184	                        idx = t.get('conversionTypeId', '') 
   185	                        if '구매완료' in name:
   186	                            conv_map["purchase"] = f"convCnt{idx}"
   187	                        elif '회원가입' in name:
   188	                            conv_map["signup"] = f"convCnt{idx}"
   189	                    print(f" [NaverAds] 전환 매핑 확인: 구매={conv_map['purchase']}, 가입={conv_map['signup']}")
   190	            except:
   191	                print(" [NaverAds] 전환 유형 조회 실패, 기본 매핑(1:구매, 2:가입) 사용")
   192	
   193	            # 2. 캠페인 리스트 조회
   194	            c_resp = requests.get(f"{self.base_url}/ncc/campaigns", headers=self._get_header('GET', '/ncc/campaigns'))
   195	            if c_resp.status_code != 200: return res
   196	            
   197	            # 3. 상세 데이터 수집
   198	            p_field = conv_map["purchase"]
   199	            s_field = conv_map["signup"]

   201	            
   202	            for camp in c_resp.json():

   205	                params = {'id': camp_id, 'fields': fields, 'timeRange': f'{{"since":"{start}","until":"{end}"}}'}
   206	                s_resp = requests.get(f"{self.base_url}/stats", headers=self._get_header('GET', '/stats'), params=params)
   207	                if s_resp.status_code == 200:
   208	                    for item in s_resp.json().get('data', []):
   209	                        res.cost += item.get('salesAmt', 0)
   210	                        res.leads += item.get('clkCnt', 0)
   211	                        res.purchase += item.get(p_field, 0)
   212	                        res.signup += item.get(s_field, 0)
   213	            
   214	            print(f" [NaverAds] 수집 완료: 비용 {res.cost:,.0f}원, 구매({p_field}) {res.purchase:.1f}, 가입({s_field}) {res.signup:.1f}")
   215	        except Exception as e: print(f"[NaverAds] 수집 중 예외 발생: {e}")
